name: phd-dissertation-completion-status
description: Academic Code §6.2.6.1 (“may apply for dissertation completion status for up to two semesters”) and DGS Handbook §3.19 / §10.3.5 — policy review 2026-10-04, P2-ac-6.2-app-7, P2-dh-3.14-3.20-27, P2-dh-10-10; DGS: “Apply the suggested fix”. A Ph.D. student who entered Fall 2020 (eight years end at the start of Fall 2028) and was granted dissertation completion status through Spring 2029, in March 2029: the time-limit row runs to the extension — In progress, “extended by the Graduate School through the end of Spring 2029” — instead of Overdue.

detailIncludes: extended by the Graduate School through the end of Spring 2029
Dissertation completion status lasts up to two semesters
